rule.title: Summary does not add up
rule.statement: the itemised summary shown in the order confirmation email is arithmetically consistent with its total, with each component counted exactly once, and each amount matches the order record

rules.text:
# Converted from the blind draft (not owner-approved). See CONVERSION.md.
- id: U1
  title: Figure differs from the order record
  kind: universal
  severity: major
  text: 'Every figure we show a shopper about their order matches what the order actually records: item prices, quantities,
    line amounts, subtotal, discounts, delivery, fees, tax, total and amount due, on every surface, once the figure can be
    known.'
  check:
    claims:
    - unit_price
    - compare_at_price
    - line_quantity
    - line_amount
    - total_quantity
    - item_total
    - discount_total
    - discount_line
    - delivery_total
    - delivery_rate_offered
    - fee_total
    - tax_total
    - order_total
    - amount_due
    - payment_amount
    must: match_oracle
    oracle: order
    when: claim.valid_in
- id: U2
  title: Same figure, different value
  kind: universal
  severity: major
  text: 'Within one pricing state, a figure reads the same wherever and whenever we show it: on the cart, each checkout step,
    the order page, both parts of the confirmation email and the admin order page. What the shopper saw on the review step
    is what the order page, the email and the admin show after they place the order.'
  check:
    claims:
    - unit_price
    - line_quantity
    - line_amount
    - total_quantity
    - item_total
    - discount_total
    - discount_line
    - delivery_total
    - fee_total
    - tax_total
    - order_total
    - amount_due
    - delivery_method_name
    - applied_code
    must: agree_across_surfaces
    same:
    - persona
    - pricing_state
    presentations_equivalent: true
- id: U3
  title: Summary does not add up
  kind: universal
  severity: major
  text: 'Every itemised summary we show is consistent with its own total: each line amount is its unit price times its quantity,
    the line amounts add up to the subtotal, and subtotal + delivery + fees + tax - discounts equals the total shown, with
    every component counted exactly once.'
  check:
    must: sums_to_own_total
    within: capture
    identities:
    - line_amount == unit_price * line_quantity
    - sum(line_amount) == item_total
    - item_total + delivery_total + fee_total + tax_total - |discount_total| == order_total
    absent_component: zero
    tolerance_cents: 0
- id: U4
  title: Order record does not add up
  kind: universal
  severity: critical
  text: 'The order record itself is internally consistent, because it is what the shopper is charged: its total is its items
    plus delivery, fees and added tax, less its discounts; its subtotal is the sum of its line prices; its discount total
    is the sum of the discounts on its lines and deliveries; its amount due is the total less gift cards and store credit;
    and its payments cover exactly the amount due.'
  check:
    must: oracle_arithmetic
    oracle: order
    identities:
    - total == item_total + delivery_total + fee_total + additional_tax_total + discount_total
    - item_total == sum(items[].price * items[].quantity)
    - discount_total == sum(items[].discount_total) + sum(fulfillments[].discount_total)
    - tax_total == additional_tax_total + included_tax_total
    - additional_tax_total == sum(items[].additional_tax_total) + sum(fulfillments[].additional_tax_total)
    - delivery_total == sum(fulfillments[].cost)
    - amount_due == total - gift_card_total - store_credit_total
    - sum(payments[].amount where status not in [failed, void, invalid]) == amount_due
    - included_tax_total == 0 and market_tax_inclusive == false
    tolerance_cents: 0
- id: U5
  title: Tax not at the store's rate
  kind: universal
  severity: major
  text: 'Sales tax is charged only where the store has a rate, at that rate, on what the shopper actually pays for: 8% of
    each taxed item''s price after its discounts for an order shipping to New York, and no tax for any other state. Tax on
    delivery, if the store taxes delivery, is 8% of the delivery charge after its discount.'
  check:
    must: rate_applied
    oracle:
    - order
    - store_config
    context_field: state
    identities:
      NY:
      - items[].additional_tax_total == round_half_up(0.08 * (items[].price * items[].quantity + items[].discount_total),
        2)   for each taxed line
      - fulfillments[].additional_tax_total in [0, round_half_up(0.08 * (fulfillments[].cost + fulfillments[].discount_total),
        2)]
      other:
      - tax_total == 0
    unknowns:
    - which tax categories the NY rate covers
    - whether delivery is taxed
    - rounding per line or per order
- id: U6
  title: Promotion does not do what it says
  kind: universal
  severity: major
  text: A promotion gives exactly what it says, and nothing is given without it. With FREESHIP accepted, the shopper pays
    nothing for delivery, whichever domestic method they chose, and item prices are untouched. Without a code, or after the
    code is removed, there is no discount at all. A surface that says a code is applied, or that delivery is free, is telling
    the truth.
  check:
    must: match_store_config
    oracle:
    - order
    - store_config
    state_field: promo
    identities:
      code_FREESHIP:
      - coupon_code == FREESHIP
      - delivery_total + sum(fulfillments[].discount_total) == 0
      - sum(items[].discount_total) == 0
      - discounts[] has one entry with code FREESHIP
      no_code_or_removed:
      - discount_total == 0
      - coupon_code is empty
    claims:
    - applied_code
    - discount_line
    judged:
      claim_kind: free_delivery_statement
      must: consistent_with_oracle
- id: U7
  title: Delivery charged is not the delivery chosen
  kind: universal
  severity: major
  text: The delivery method on the order and on every surface is the one the shopper chose, every option is offered at the
    price the store set for it, and the delivery charged is the price of the option chosen.
  check:
    must: match_store_config
    oracle:
    - order
    - store_config
    context_field: delivery_method
    identities:
    - fulfillments[].delivery_method.name == persona.delivery_method
    - fulfillments[].delivery_rates[selected].name == persona.delivery_method
    - fulfillments[].cost == fulfillments[].delivery_rates[selected].cost
    - fulfillments[].delivery_rates[name].cost == store_config.delivery_methods[name]   for each offered rate
    - fulfillments[].cost == store_config.delivery_methods[persona.delivery_method]   for each fulfillment
    claims:
    - delivery_rate_offered
    - delivery_method_name
- id: U8
  title: A charge the shopper is not shown
  kind: universal
  severity: major
  text: 'Every part of what the shopper pays is shown to them before they pay and on their confirmation: on the review step,
    the order page and the confirmation email, the summary shows the subtotal, each nonzero discount, delivery, each nonzero
    fee, tax and the total.'
  check:
    must: present_when_nonzero
    surfaces:
    - storefront_checkout.review
    - storefront_order_page
    - order_email_html
    - order_email_text
    components:
    - item_total
    - discount_total
    - delivery_total
    - fee_total
    - tax_total
    - order_total
    always:
    - item_total
    - delivery_total
    - order_total
- id: U9
  title: Order details do not match
  kind: universal
  severity: minor
  text: 'The order details we confirm are the shopper''s own: the order number, email, delivery address, items and their options,
    delivery method, payment method and code agree across the order page, both email parts and the admin, match the order
    record, and match what the shopper entered. Status words match the order''s real status.'
  check:
    claims:
    - order_number
    - shopper_email
    - ship_to
    - item_name
    - item_options
    - delivery_method_name
    - payment_method_name
    - applied_code
    - payment_status
    - fulfillment_status
    must: match_oracle
    oracle: order
- id: U9.agree
  title: Order details do not match
  kind: universal
  severity: minor
  text: 'The order details we confirm are the shopper''s own: the order number, email, delivery address, items and their options,
    delivery method, payment method and code agree across the order page, both email parts and the admin, match the order
    record, and match what the shopper entered. Status words match the order''s real status.'
  check:
    claims:
    - order_number
    - shopper_email
    - ship_to
    - item_name
    - item_options
    - delivery_method_name
    - payment_method_name
    - applied_code
    - payment_status
    - fulfillment_status
    must: agree_across_surfaces
    oracle: order
- id: U9.persona
  title: Order details do not match
  kind: universal
  severity: minor
  text: 'The order details we confirm are the shopper''s own: the order number, email, delivery address, items and their options,
    delivery method, payment method and code agree across the order page, both email parts and the admin, match the order
    record, and match what the shopper entered. Status words match the order''s real status.'
  check:
    claims:
    - order_number
    - shopper_email
    - ship_to
    - item_name
    - item_options
    - delivery_method_name
    - payment_method_name
    - applied_code
    - payment_status
    - fulfillment_status
    must: match_persona
    oracle: order
- id: P1
  title: Partial total not labelled as partial
  kind: conditional
  severity: major
  text: A figure presented as the total is what the shopper will pay. Before the address and delivery are known, tax and delivery
    cannot be known yet, so a summary may show a total without them, but only if it says what is not yet included.
  applies_to:
    claims:
    - order_total
    where: claim.value != oracle.total in final_pricing_state
  exceptions:
  - id: P1-E1
    conditions:
    - id: a
      kind: data
      test: state_unset
      params:
        state:
        - address
        - delivery
        any: true
    - id: b
      kind: data
      test: summary_adds_up
      params:
        rule: U3
    - id: c
      kind: judged
      field: labels_missing_components
    scope:
      features:
      - core
      surfaces:
      - storefront_cart
      - storefront_checkout.address
      - storefront_checkout.delivery
    approved:
      by: pending_owner_review
- id: L1
  title: Confirmation email missing or duplicated
  kind: load
  severity: minor
  text: Each placed order sends the shopper exactly one order confirmation email, carrying the items, totals, addresses and
    delivery method.
  count:
    channels:
    - email
    topics:
    - order_confirmation
    per: order
    min: 1
    max: 1
    window_hours: 1
